o1.biggest_strength: It really uses the data: taste first, 3 pm habit, price objection, variety pack details, and paid disclosure are all built into the scripts.
o1.biggest_mistake: It is a bit overbuilt and likely over the word limit, with extra testing and rights sections I did not ask for; a few creator lines sound more like a marketer than a real person.
o1.what_would_make_it_a_10: Trim the extra strategy sections, polish the spoken lines to feel more natural, and keep only the most shoot-ready guidance while preserving the strong disclosure and price handling.

o2.biggest_strength: The scripts are clean, easy to shoot, and sound warm and natural for creators without drifting into banned health language.
o2.biggest_mistake: The paid-ad disclosure is weaker inside the actual scripts, and the price objection is mostly handled in only one script instead of being answered more consistently.
o2.what_would_make_it_a_10: Add clear on-screen or spoken ad disclosure in each script, handle the $3-per-can objection more directly, and make the family script a little more careful with kids and claims.

reason: I would rather use Output 1 because it understands the business problem more deeply and bakes in the strongest signals from the comments and ad data. Output 2 is cleaner and more natural, but Output 1 is closer to a performance-ready UGC brief after light trimming.
